paper_title: dKV-Cache The Cache for Diffusion Language Models
caption: Impact of batch size on decoding speed. Evaluated on LLaDA with a single NVIDIA H20; prefill length fixed at 100 tokens.

model_annotations.English: This line plot illustrates the impact of batch size on decoding speed, representing two methods (dKV-Cache-Decode and Origin) across four different configurations (L = 16, 32, 64, and 128). The x-axis is labeled "Batch Size" and utilizes a linear scale ranging from 0 to 120 (with data extending to 128), featuring numeric tick marks spaced at regular intervals of 20. The y-axis is labeled "Token/s" and uses a linear scale ranging from 25 to 225, with tick marks spaced every 25 units. The plot contains eight lines that employ varying marker shapes at different x-axis values, such as downward triangles at a batch size of 32, leftward triangles at 64, and pentagons at 128. The solid light grey line represents dKV-Cache-Decode at L = 16; it rises steeply from an unannotated starting value near 40, passing through annotated points at a batch size of 32 (173.17 Token/s) and 64 (189.74 Token/s), before ending at 128 (202.31 Token/s). The solid blue line representing dKV-Cache-Decode at L = 32 rises continuously through annotated values of 159.24 at a batch size of 32, 175.95 at 64, and reaches 183.28 at 128. The solid salmon line for dKV-Cache-Decode at L = 64 increases from below 25 to annotated points of 119.55 at a batch size of 32, 126.86 at 64, and finishes at 130.58 at 128. The solid dark navy line for dKV-Cache-Decode at L = 128 rises to annotated values of 75.72 at a batch size of 32, 78.76 at 64, and 81.18 at 128. The dashed light grey line representing the Origin method at L = 16 exhibits an initial increase before maintaining a steady trend across annotated points of 67.19 at a batch size of 32, 69.28 at 64, and ending at 69.62 at 128. The dashed blue line for Origin at L = 32 flattens across annotated values of 58.51 at a batch size of 32, 59.43 at 64, and 59.71 at 128. The dashed salmon line for Origin at L = 64 stabilizes through points of 46.69 at a batch size of 32, 48.53 at 64, and 48.93 at 128. Finally, the dashed dark navy line for Origin at L = 128 maintains a nearly flat trajectory across annotated values of 34.53 at a batch size of 32, 34.95 at 64, and 35.42 at a batch size of 128.
